faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Aion 2 timers.

items.question: Does this site have live timers or an interactive calculator?
items.answer: No. It currently provides guides and manual worksheets. No verified live server feed, coordinate database or interactive skill tree is available.

items.question: Where should I check an event time?
items.answer: Use the current in-game notice or official AION 2 announcement for your server. Record the full date and time zone.

items.question: Can the worksheet validate my build?
items.answer: No. It records your inputs; you must verify costs and prerequisites in the current game.
